svg.title: Lower custom clocks continue after rejected intermediate steps
svg.desc: At most ten planned steps lower the clock at the proven sweep voltage. Cached points are skipped, ordinary rejections continue downward, and only eligible passing curves can reach final verification.

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Custom target below
the passing sweep clock

div.style: color: rgb(237, 245, 250) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Plan ≤10 lower-clock steps
Keep proven sweep voltage
